title: Retractable Hooks and Garment Rod Wall Mount Hook with 2-1/2-Inch Hanging Space (Carolina Collection) Allied Brass
body_html:
Upgrade your space with a retractable hooks and garment rod wall mount hook that adds 2-1/2 inches of hanging space when you need it, then retracts neatly out of the way.

  • Retractable design: Rod pulls out for 2-1/2" of hanging space and pushes back in when not in use
  • Strong everyday support: Holds up to 15 lb for coats, robes, or towels
  • Crafted in brass: Solid brass construction with traditional, refined Carolina collection styling
  • Customizable detail: Supplied knob tip can be removed and replaced with a cabinet knob of your own
  • Wall mount installation: Fits standard interior walls; mounting hardware included

Specs

  • Collection: Carolina (Traditional/Classic)
  • Mounting: Wall mount
  • Overall size: 3.75" W x 1.75" H x 1.75" L
  • Projection: 1"
  • Hanging space: 2-1/2"
  • Weight capacity: 15 lb
  • Installation: Drill a 3/4" diameter hole through drywall and 3 small holes around; uses 6/32 toggles
  • Product weight: 1 lb
  • Finish options: Available in 28 designer finishes, including statement colors such as lavender, autumn sparkle, fire engine red, golden yellow, and spanish gold

Pair with matching Carolina collection pieces to keep a cohesive, traditional bathroom hardware look throughout the room.

_previous.title: Carolina Retractable Wall Hook
_previous.description: Avondale Decor's retractable wall hook is a unique and space-saving solution for hanging coats, robes, towels, or any other items you need to keep within reach. The hook installs quickly and easily without the need for additional support on or built into the wall — just drill a hole and use the included toggle bolts to fasten it in place. The rod pulls out to provide 2-1/2" of hanging space, then can be pushed back in so it's out of the way when not in use. Choose from 17 stylish finishes and four different models to match your decor.
